source_only_concepts.meaning_summary: Flora concerns actions and methods spreading into wider lives and systems through fragmentation and dispersal.
Ixion describes unfinished patterns repeating and inward reworking during retrograde.
Nessus concerns transmission of inherited residue, distinguished from the wound itself, and recognizing cycles that can be interrupted.
Sedna concerns long-delayed consequences of longstanding causes becoming visible.
